digest.component_or_area: CLI command structure - bridge verb group
propositions: Three legacy bridge verbs (bridge-fsck, bridge-probe, jira-onboard) must be renamed to canonical nested spellings (rebar bridge fsck, rebar bridge check-access, rebar bridge setup)
Old spelling names must remain functional as backward-compatible compatibility entrypoints without behavioral changes, delegating to identical implementation paths
All enumerated consumers across CLI dispatch, help text, tests, schemas, scripts, docs, and workflows must be migrated to new canonical spellings while preserving compatibility aliases
The bridge_fsck schema $id and description fields must reference the new verb spelling; schema-coverage and MCP contract tests must validate against new registration
Every string-reference site including test monkeypatches, literal string assertions, and documentation examples must be migrated or explicitly categorized as compatibility/historical artifacts
